bioschemas.name: BioExcel Building Blocks Workflows (BioBB-Wfs)
bioschemas.summary: BioBB Wfs extends and complements the BioBB library offering web-based access to a collection of predefined biomolecular simulation workflows built using the BioExcel Building Blocks library. Molecular Dynamics setup, docking, ligand parameterization, and flexibility analyses are examples of workflows included in the website.
